body:
The hosted adversarial review of PR #208 at `c432eaf91cb071c956d20be490184a9ce41cf73e` found a minor unsupported spatial claim in the README catalogue row for barićite: “G20-associated phosphate precipitation around iron nails.”

Han et al. (2016), DOI [10.1016/j.chemgeo.2016.04.022](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.chemgeo.2016.04.022), §3.2 distinguishes black sulfide material on the iron nail from white phosphate solids in the inoculated acetate medium. The existing barićite record already preserves that distinction; this finding concerns the README summary only.

Acceptance:
- Replace the spatial claim with “Barićite-assigned phosphate precipitation in hydrogen-fed G20 cultures,” or equivalently bounded wording.
- Prove the scientific record/history/review bytes are unchanged.
- Update affected publication hashes and append a successor review; retain the original negative observation.
- Re-review the corrected exact PR commit and run the affected publication/provenance checks before native queue admission.

Negative reviewer receipt: `/private/tmp/cmm-round66-hosted-peer-20261014T083940673181Z.json`, issue key `round66-baricite-readme-spatial`. This is separate from original acquisition/assessment issue #205 and Daye source follow-up #207.
title: Correct unsupported barićite precipitation location in README
